findings.text:
DSPK-1: 1 part to fix
DSPK-1[code]: On resume, stage k (the interrupted stage) is dispatched and emits stage.start covers: RESU-3 RESU-4
  Given: A run with stages 1…N was interrupted during stage k; stages 1…k-1 are marked complete with their artifacts present in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after rehydration
  When: The dispatch loop reaches stage k during resume
  Then: Stage k is dispatched — when k is a cycle stage, a cycle.start event is emitted for k and stage.start is emitted for k's first non-complete cycle member (the interrupted member, via the CMBR-1 resume_first_iter path); when k is a leaf stage, a stage.start event is emitted for k [FIX IN DESIGN: names the internal code path that produces the observable event rather than stating only the observable outcome; a test can observe the stage.start emission without knowing which internal path caused it — say what someone could see happen, not how it is built]
